title.value: Optimising Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement using Advanced Discrete Choice Models
title.justification: The title is verbatim from the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Optimising Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement using Advanced Discrete Choice Models

extractions.description: The paper discusses the optimization of electric vehicle charging station placements using advanced discrete choice models. The aim is to increase EV adoption by optimizing the placement of charging stations considering various user classes and infrastructure costs. It uses a simulation-based method for modeling user decisions to purchase EVs based on available charging infrastructure. The paper also compares different optimization models and heuristics to solve the problem effectively.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing EV charging station placements to reduce CO2 emissions, which directly relates to climate change mitigation efforts.
climate_change_is_central.quote: In order to meet CO 2 emissions goals, major changes at the global level are necessary. This includes the transportation sector, which in 2019 was responsible for 27% of global CO 2 emissions...

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on increasing EV adoption by optimizing infrastructure, which is aimed at reducing CO2 emissions, a key aspect of climate change mitigation.
primary_category.quote: ...One initiative that has been proposed to reduce these emissions is the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), rather than internal combustion engine vehicles (ICEVs)...

secondary_categories.justification: Although not the main focus, the infrastructure planning aspect can indirectly support climate adaptation efforts by promoting resilient infrastructure systems.
secondary_categories.quote: ...The goal of the decision makers is to plan the placement of charging infrastructure...

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically addresses the transportation sector by optimizing EV charging station placements to reduce emissions from traditional vehicles.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...The problem we examine is that of the decision makers responsible for public charging infrastructure, and the optimal placement of that infrastructure within a city.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The optimization of EV charging locations can influence grid demand and renewable integration into the transport sector.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: ...governmental organisations can alleviate this problem by investing in public charging infrastructure, thus allowing users to recharge EVs and encourage EV adoption.

applications.value: Optimizing the placement of EV charging stations to increase EV adoption
applications.justification: The paper's main application is optimizing the placement of charging stations to encourage EV adoption and thus reduce CO2 emissions.
applications.quote: ...The goal of the decision makers is to plan the placement of charging infrastructure so that it maximises EV adoption.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories accurately capture the paper's central theme.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories accurately reflect the paper's focus areas.
